title: Scope contract
description: The root declaration of what the agent may observe. Every downstream artifact binds to canonicalHash, so this is the anchor of the evidence chain. Never committed with real values: the framework ships this schema and placeholder examples only (NFR-02).

subscriptionRef.description: Names an external reference rather than carrying a subscription identifier. A single subscription in v1; widening to a list later is additive, because a consumer pinned to this version keeps validating (CC-C01).

inScope.description: An empty selection is rejected structurally as well as semantically. Without minItems a contract that selects nothing would validate, and the agent it provisioned would observe nothing while appearing correctly configured (FR-28).

outOfScope.description: Required but may be empty. Exclusions are declared explicitly and never implied by omission, so the difference between 'not selected' and 'deliberately excluded' survives into the evidence chain.

executionLimits.description: All four limits are required. An omitted limit would fall back to a runtime default that this contract does not state, so the bound would exist without being declared.

generatedAt.description: When the selection was taken. Point-in-time snapshot metadata, so drift between selection and deployment is detectable rather than silent.

generatedAgainst.description: An opaque marker for the state the selection was taken against, such as a discovery run identifier. Not a resource identifier: this file is committed.

canonicalHash.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical form of this document with this property removed, lowercase hex (ADR-0004). Self-exclusion is part of the definition: a document carrying its own digest while it was computed could never reproduce it.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the instance conforms to (FR-05, FR-29). Pinned with const rather than left to the pattern: without it an instance could declare any version at all and still validate, which made the declaration decorative (NFR-21).

identifier.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated. Constrained so an identifier cannot carry arbitrary text, and English by construction (FR-03, CON-01).

externalReferenceName.description: Names an entry in the framework configuration's externalReferences. That the named entry resolves is a semantic check; JSON Schema cannot reach another document.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339, UTC, Z-suffixed. The pattern is present because format is an annotation by default: without it, 'next tuesday' would validate as a date-time. UTC is required so two timestamps can be compared lexically.

sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex, exactly 64 characters, as ADR-0004 pins. Uppercase is rejected rather than folded: a digest that compares unequal to its own recomputation is the failure this field exists to detect.

observationPeriod.description: An end that precedes its start is rejected by a semantic check; JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling values (FR-28).

kind.description: Selection mechanism, deliberately not a workload type. The core ships no workload-type content of its own (FR-63, CC-022).

selector.description: A placeholder in every shipped example. A literal resource identifier here would be a customer environment identifier in a committed file.
